answer: NovaOps does not allow employees to use a personal laptop for work, except for a five-business-day IT continuity exception when a managed laptop is being repaired or replaced and the employee has no working device. IT must approve and log the exception before the employee uses a personal machine, even for those five days. Personal laptops are not allowed otherwise.
